test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that completes the sentence using the correct spelling.

There are two types of ________ : viral and bacterial.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pneumonia**" refers to a respiratory infection that affects the lungs.
 
• The correct spelling is "**pneumonia**", which begins with "pneu-" and not "neumonia", "pnumonia", or "newmonia".
 
• **Pneumonia** can be categorized into two types: viral and bacterial.

Correct sentence: *There are two types of **pneumonia**: viral and bacterial.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Viral Pneumonia:** Caused by viruses such as influenza or respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
 
• **Bacterial Pneumonia:** Caused by bacteria, most commonly Streptococcus pneumoniae.
 
• **Symptoms:** Symptoms of pneumonia include cough, fever, shortness of breath, and chest pain.
